audience: Android phone and tablet first; accessible controller-first variant on TV
currentProblem: Plain AlertDialog, two text buttons for editions and 14 empty hex text fields hide actual colours and push Apply below fold

layout.title: Appearance
layout.top: Three visible preset cards or horizontal carousel on narrow devices; show actual cartridge-and-shelf preview built from current semantic colours; every card has name, real swatch strip and selected border/check
layout.preview: Shared live preview: 2 Arc-Rail spines + shelf backboard + rail; on selection immediately reflect all cartridge and shelf tokens; fallback not game licensed art
layout.controls: Choose edition | Customise colours | Save as new | Accessibility settings; keep Cancel/Apply visible using sticky footer; no giant blank input stack
layout.swatchRoleList: Tappable swatch rows grouped Cartridge, Shelf, Lighting and Accessibility; display actual colour square, role, value and optional reset badge; hide advanced unused tokens until group opened
layout.tokenEditor: Tap colour square opens palette sheet with 6-8 curated swatch chips, current colour visible, optional native HSV picker and advanced hex entry; preview updates without committing until Apply
layout.preferredHeight: Full-screen or expandable bottom sheet on phone rather than a 14-field AlertDialog
layout.selectedIndicator: Accessible selected state not colour alone
layout.motion: Quick crossfade/tint of preview only; reduced-motion immediate
layout.typography: No marketing slogans or long instructions; concise functional labels

customThemes.store: Versioned local application preferences; migrate current ShelfAppearance(edition,custom,highContrast,reducedMotion) non-destructively
customThemes.stableIDs: UUIDs in preference layer; never game ID
customThemes.persistence: Restart and app update; never ROM, SRAM, save state, indexed games, or shelf placement records
customThemes.invalidColors: Prevent save or reset offending role to derived safe value with visible inline guidance; do not silently alter other roles
customThemes.backupExport: Deferred; don't require new network or file permissions

implementation.greenRequirement: Add GREEN branch to native preset enum / cartridge tokens, and adopt 3-way shelf selection instead of canonicalShelfMaterials(pink:Boolean) boolean
implementation.migration: Keep existing version-one layout and appearance as readable; do not require destructive game/shelf migration. Optional separate appearance store/schema v2 or backward-compatible appearance extension approved by Daniel
implementation.previewAndSave: Use temporary Compose state; cancel restores applied appearance and custom themes unchanged; Apply persists atomically
implementation.preserveScope: No emulator renderer, PadKit, ROM scanning, file permissions, save paths or copyrighted game imagery changes
implementation.delivery: Independent UI polish feature PR after or alongside existing P1-A2 code; avoid rebasing unreleased binaries from obsolete branches

qa: Original/Pink/Green card shows actual preset colours and realistic shelf/case mini preview
Preset selection updates all visible surfaces, controls and shelf without changing geometry
Original values visible in colour rows on first entry; no empty hex form as default
Tapped swatch shows curated choices; accessibility announces colour and selected state
Named user theme can be saved/renamed/duplicated/applied/deleted without changing factory themes
Cancel leaves current applied edition and saved names unchanged
Existing V1 custom overrides survive migration and can be saved as named copy
High contrast and reduced motion persist independently across presets
Invalid role and low contrast handled with visible feedback
Original/Pink/Green survive restart, screen rotation and in-place debug update
Cartridge family and shelf use same identity and theme together; cover/game image untouched
393dp screenshot, large type, TalkBack/focus, portrait/landscape/tablet and dark/light device mode proof
